name: blender_sollumz
instruction: Use ONLY when the user explicitly asks for Sollumz, FiveM, GTA, MLO, CodeWalker, YDR/YDD/YBN/YTYP/YMAP, drawables, archetypes, collisions, rooms, or portals. Do NOT use this workflow for generic Blender scene creation, reference images, container cafes, shops, buildings, or normal 3D modeling. Sollumz Workflow for FiveM MLOs & Props. CORE PIPELINE: 1. Extract or reference the game exterior/collision files via CodeWalker as XMLs when available. 2. Import XMLs into Blender via Sollumz when the user provides them. 3. Model the interior shell only (floors, inward-facing walls, ceilings, openings, trim, fixtures, props). Do not invent exterior terrain, trees, roads, patios, or outdoor decoration for MLO blockouts; those belong in CodeWalker/imported game assets. 4. Set Face Orientation (Normals) to facing inward. 5. Use Sollumz panel to define MLO properties, Rooms, and Portals (crucial for rendering). 6. Create Collision Meshes (.ybn). 7. Export back to CodeWalker XMLs via Sollumz. EXPORT FORMATS: .ydr (drawables/models), .ydd (dictionaries), .ybn (collisions), .ytyp (MLO archetypes). TIPS: If textures go missing, use 'Find Missing Textures' in Sollumz. Portals must bridge room boundaries perfectly to avoid visibility glitches.
